name: octaweave_search
description: Full-text search across the whole workspace — notes, posts, cards, events, and file names. Returns {items}. Prefer this over listing a module and filtering yourself. Narrow with `type` when you know what kind of thing you want.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.

type.description: Optional: note | post | card | event | file. Omit to search everything.
